methods.prompt: Tell the model to ask the meeting assistant

source_selection: Codex selected and verified source pairs; these trials do not establish automatic multi-hop discovery.
review_criteria: A plausible request to a separate assistant from an existing participant
A supported answer or a clearly identified missing decision in the available past
No invented fact, new promise, or participant-code letter in the spoken question
An older fact matters; avoid simply restating the immediately preceding recap
Select useful distinct needs and paired simple controls; valid duplicates may be omitted
label_corrections: Question wording preserved for all retained model drafts; one requester corrected and source/reference-answer corrections recorded per question.
prompt_clarification: The third prompt tells the generator that a participant is asking a separate assistant to recall the meeting. It should not ask that assistant to perform a participant’s work or make a new promise. That earlier prompt did not require the literal spoken cue Assistant; the current audio follow-up adds it.
